speaker.name: Reliability Ruth
speaker.role: Develops the end-user applications and services that integrate ML models. Handles model deployment, configuration, and continuous monitoring of real-world performance. Employs feedback loops to facilitate iterative improvements and system reliability.

output.objection: Tracking contract execution is just a smoke alarm, not the plumbing. I need the pipeline to actually halt and quarantine the loyalty basket feed the moment a consent flag flips, otherwise we are still shipping tainted forecasts.
output.correction: I am not asking for a dashboard that tells us we failed after the fact. I am asking for a hard gate in the ingestion layer that rejects the personal data stream if the contract terms are not met.
